smallshipsheraldry.help.title: Heraldry Table guide
smallshipsheraldry.help.layout: The Paint, Parts, and View buttons above the model switch the contents of the side panels.
smallshipsheraldry.help.paint: In Paint mode, choose a tool on the left and set the colour and brush size on the right. Use My colours to save colours to your palette, or Actions to fill or clear the current sail stage. When parts are selected, painting and filling affect only those parts.
smallshipsheraldry.help.parts: In Parts mode, left-click parts in the list or on the model to select them. Ctrl + LMB adds or removes individual parts, while Shift + LMB selects a range in the list. Right-click a row to hide a part; the buttons on the right let you select all parts, deselect, hide selected parts, or show only those parts. The arrow on the left collapses the list.
smallshipsheraldry.help.view: Open View to toggle the grid, choose a camera preset, or reset the camera. Hold RMB to rotate the model, Shift + RMB or MMB to pan, and scroll to zoom; these camera controls work in every mode.
smallshipsheraldry.help.navigation: Use the arrows below the model to change ship type or sail stage. You can also select stages with keys 1–5 or cycle through them with [ and ]. Each ship type keeps its own drawing, and painting one stage does not change the others.
smallshipsheraldry.help.controls: Hold LMB to paint on the sail; Alt + LMB picks a colour from the drawing without switching to the colour picker. Press Ctrl + Z to undo, or Ctrl + Y or Ctrl + Shift + Z to redo. Tool shortcuts are shown in their tooltips.
smallshipsheraldry.help.selection: Choose Selection (M), then hold LMB and drag over the area you want to copy with Ctrl + C or cut with Ctrl + X. After Ctrl + V, position the fragment with the mouse or arrow keys; hold Shift for 8-pixel steps. Enter confirms the paste, and Del erases the selected area. Esc cancels the paste or clears the selection before closing the editor.
smallshipsheraldry.help.library: The table saves drafts automatically; to move a pattern between worlds or servers, save it in Library. Use Open folder to find its .sshpattern file and share it with another player, or drag a file into the editor to import it.
smallshipsheraldry.help.workflow: To print, left-click the paper slot at the lower right to add paper from your inventory, click Print, then left-click the adjacent output slot to collect the pattern. Right-click the paper slot to take one sheet back; hold Shift to add or take back all available paper.
smallshipsheraldry.help.apply: With the pattern in hand, Shift + right-click a ship of the type shown in the item's tooltip. Replacing an installed pattern returns the old one.
smallshipsheraldry.help.duplicate: To copy a printed pattern, place it in the centre of a crafting table and surround it with 8 sheets of paper to get two identical patterns.
smallshipsheraldry.help.remove: With shears in hand, Shift + right-click the ship to erase its pattern and restore the previous sail colour. The pattern will not drop as an item.
